test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

To add fuel to fire.

options.text: To make a bad situation worse

solution:
The correct answer is** 'To make a bad situation worse.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "To add fuel to the fire" is an idiom that means to do or say something that makes an already difficult or tense situation even worse. (पहले से मुश्किल या तनावपूर्ण स्थिति को और बदतर बनाने के लिए कुछ करना)
 
• Example Sentence: By making fun of John's new haircut in front of everyone, Peter just added fuel to the fire.

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1**
